issue.title: Require the `google_cloud_rpc` release that adds `retry.dart` in `google_cloud_storage` and `google_cloud_pubsub`
issue.body_html:
#352 moves RetryRunner, ExponentialRetry, and ChecksumValidationException into package:google_cloud_rpc, but the latest published google_cloud_rpc (0.6.0) doesn't include them. The workspace resolves the local copy, so CI won't catch that google_cloud_storage still allows google_cloud_rpc: ^0.6.0.

Once the generated google_cloud_rpc version has been bumped:

  • Require the new version in pkgs/google_cloud_storage/pubspec.yaml (as #333 did for 0.6.0) and mention it in the CHANGELOG, before releasing google_cloud_storage 0.6.5.
  • Do the same in pkgs/google_cloud_pubsub/pubspec.yaml before publishing google_cloud_pubsub, since it imports package:google_cloud_rpc/retry.dart from #353 on.

#352 moves `RetryRunner`, `ExponentialRetry`, and `ChecksumValidationException` into `package:google_cloud_rpc`, but the latest published `google_cloud_rpc` (0.6.0) doesn't include them. The workspace resolves the local copy, so CI won't catch that `google_cloud_storage` still allows `google_cloud_rpc: ^0.6.0`.

Once the generated `google_cloud_rpc` version has been bumped:

- [ ] Require the new version in `pkgs/google_cloud_storage/pubspec.yaml` (as #333 did for 0.6.0) and mention it in the CHANGELOG, before releasing `google_cloud_storage` 0.6.5.
- [ ] Do the same in `pkgs/google_cloud_pubsub/pubspec.yaml` before publishing `google_cloud_pubsub`, since it imports `package:google_cloud_rpc/retry.dart` from #353 on.

issue.title: feat(google_cloud_rpc): extract shared RetryRunner and ExponentialRetry
issue.body_html:
Moves the retry support from package:google_cloud_storage into
package:google_cloud_rpc so that other packages (starting with
package:google_cloud_pubsub) can share it.

  • RetryRunner, ExponentialRetry, NoDelayRetry, defaultRetry, and
    delaySequence move to package:google_cloud_rpc/retry.dart, and
    ChecksumValidationException moves to
    package:google_cloud_rpc/exceptions.dart.
    package:google_cloud_storage still exports everything it exported
    before, so existing imports keep working.
  • ExponentialRetry gains an optional jitter that randomizes each
    delay, and value equality. RetryRunner gains isRetryable (which
    also recognizes gRPC status codes) and delays, and RetryRunner.run
    takes an optional clock.
  • retry_test.dart moves along with the code.
  • google_cloud_rpc is a generated package, so librarian.yaml now
    keeps the new hand-written files and lists the new clock and meta
    dependencies.
  • google_cloud_storage is bumped to 0.6.5-wip. Before it is published,
    it will need to require the next google_cloud_rpc release (#366).

Split out from #292 (1/4).
Closes #346

issue.title: feat(google_cloud_pubsub): add Pub/Sub retry configuration and gRPC error mapping
issue.body_html:
Adds the defaultRetry configuration (ExponentialRetry with 100ms
initial delay, 1.3x multiplier, 60s maximum delay, 1m maximum
retry interval, and ±20% jitter), re-exports RetryRunner,
ExponentialRetry, and NoDelayRetry from package:google_cloud_rpc,
and populates ServiceException.status in PubSub._mapGrpcError.

package:google_cloud_rpc models exceptions by HTTP status code
(ConflictException for 409, InternalServerErrorException for 500,
etc.) and includes an optional ServiceException.status field holding
the underlying google.rpc.Status (code, message, details). While
REST clients populate status in ServiceException.fromHttpResponse,
PubSub._mapGrpcError previously left status as null when
converting gRPC GrpcErrors into ServiceExceptions.

Because gRPC has more granular status codes than HTTP
(google/rpc/code.proto), multiple gRPC codes with opposite retry
behavior in Pub/Sub
collapse into the same HTTP exception class:

  • ConflictException (HTTP 409): used for both ALREADY_EXISTS
    (code 6, non-retryable) and ABORTED (code 10, retryable).
  • InternalServerErrorException (HTTP 500): used for INTERNAL
    (code 13, retryable), UNKNOWN (code 2, retryable), and
    DATA_LOSS (code 15, non-retryable).

Populating ServiceException.status with
Status(code: e.code, message: message) in _mapGrpcError preserves
the original gRPC status code so ExponentialRetry.isRetryable (and
callers) can distinguish these cases.

Split out from #292 (2/4).

initial delay, `1.3x` multiplier, `60s` maximum delay, `1m` maximum

and populates `ServiceException.status` in `PubSub._mapGrpcError`.

etc.) and includes an optional `ServiceException.status` field holding
the underlying `google.rpc.Status` (`code`, `message`, `details`). While
REST clients populate `status` in `ServiceException.fromHttpResponse`,

converting gRPC `GrpcError`s into `ServiceException`s.

(`google/rpc/code.proto`), multiple gRPC codes with **opposite retry
behavior** in [Pub/Sub](https://cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/retry-requests)
collapse into the same HTTP exception class:
- **`ConflictException` (HTTP 409):** used for both `ALREADY_EXISTS`
  (code 6, **non-retryable**) and `ABORTED` (code 10, **retryable**).
- **`InternalServerErrorException` (HTTP 500):** used for `INTERNAL`
  (code 13, **retryable**), `UNKNOWN` (code 2, **retryable**), and
  `DATA_LOSS` (code 15, **non-retryable**).

`Status(code: e.code, message: message)` in `_mapGrpcError` preserves
the original gRPC status code so `ExponentialRetry.isRetryable` (and
callers) can distinguish these cases.
